gates.citation: Welch PD (1967). The use of fast Fourier transform for the estimation of power spectra. IEEE Trans Audio Electroacoust 15(2):70-73. Reference impl: scipy.signal.welch (Virtanen et al. 2020). Data: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb), PhysioNet.

reference.citation: Welch PD (1967). The use of fast Fourier transform for the estimation of power spectra. IEEE Trans Audio Electroacoust 15(2):70-73. Reference impl: scipy.signal.welch (Virtanen et al. 2020). Data: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb), PhysioNet.
reference.description: re-computes every channel's five EEG-band powers with scipy.signal.welch (symmetric Hann, nperseg=256, noverlap=128, detrend=False, scaling='density') over the identical band indices, and reports the mean delta + alpha power, the mean and peak relative alpha (eyes-closed posterior-alpha topography), the bit-exact scipy agreement (~7e-13), and the 64-channel/5-band counts
